text: S is in place. L and T are in the word, in the wrong place.
Was Delphine Rooke in the dining room?
The inspector says no. One question left today.

facts: Delphine Rooke had the iron poker.
Colonel Rufus Hale did not have the marble bust.
The iron poker was in the library.
The vial of foxglove was in the morning room.

facts.text: Was Delphine Rooke in the dining room? **No.**

text: It was Delphine Rooke, with the iron poker, in the library.

blocks.title: Confirm your accusation
blocks.question: Accuse **Delphine Rooke** of the murder, with the **iron poker**, in the **library**?
blocks.note: This is the one accusation today. Once confirmed, it can’t be changed.

text: This week’s room: The Locked Study. A desk, a rug, a safe and a note pinned to the wall. What do you search first?
The lock clicks and the heavy oak door swings open. You’re out of the Clockmaker’s Study.
Delve. I creep past the guard post.
You slip by, but your lantern catches a goblin’s eye. Threat rises to 3.
Can I see the store in my browser?
